svg.title: VwapPullback: end-to-end workflow and default settings
svg.text: VwapPullback: end-to-end workflow and default settings
Long-only trend continuation after a pullback to VWAP. VwapScanner.Android (read-only: finds signals, sizes a simulated portfolio, monitors exits).
Scan now (button) or Auto-refresh every N minutes until 15:30 IST (starts automatically when the app opens).
Optional replay: a past date and "as of" time (empty = today, now). Settings are re-read at every scan.
The strategy chosen in Settings > Scan > Strategy is applied to the next scan.
Historical 1-minute candles per stock, cached per instrument and day; only missing minutes are fetched.
Only COMPLETED candles are used (candle end time <= "as of" time). Polling, not a live tick feed.
The scan checks the latest candle and the last N candles (Lookback) of every stock.
3. NIFTY 50 benchmark gate (shared by both strategies)
A separate VWAP state is built for NIFTY 50 from the same candles.
A candle time is blocked when the benchmark is in a downtrend: EMA5 < EMA13 AND 3-candle momentum < 0.
Stock signals at blocked times are skipped (shown as "NIFTY downtrend" in the diagnostics text).
Per stock, per completed candle. Fixed: VWAP series, ATR 10, EMA 9 / 20, relative volume vs prior 20.
Ready after 31 candles (first decision ~09:46). Long-only trend continuation: buy the bounce after a dip to VWAP.
ALL must pass on the signal candle:
1 window: decision time inside entry window 2 volume and turnover minimums
3 confirmation: green candle, close > previous HIGH, upper half of range, close > VWAP
4 uptrend: >= 70% of last 30 closes above VWAP, VWAP rose >= 0.5 ATR over 30 candles,
EMA9 > EMA20, latest swing high AND swing low higher than the previous ones (3 candles each side)
5 VWAP touch in the last 8 candles: low <= VWAP + 0.3 ATR and >= VWAP - 0.5 ATR (deeper = breakdown)
6 risk = close - stop within 0.5 to 2.5 ATR 7 room: day high - close >= 1.5 x risk
8 target distance >= min bps. Cool-down: one signal per pullback (next 8 candles dropped).
Pullback low = lowest low since first touch. Stop = min(pullback low, VWAP) - 0.25 x ATR Risk = close - stop
Target = close + 2.0 x risk Score = 1 + min(rv,3)/3 + min(VWAP slope,2)/2 + min(room/risk,3)/6
StretchAtr is negative (close above VWAP). "Net gain at VWAP" is a downside scenario, not an expected gain.
Min room to day high (x risk)
5. Indicators and optional filters (RSI, SuperTrend, EMA 9/20)
Every signal carries RSI, SuperTrend direction and EMA fast / slow, shown on screen and in the CSV
Filters are applied AFTER the VwapPullback rules and are all OFF by default (behavior unchanged until you switch one on):
SuperTrend filter: keep the signal only if price is above the SuperTrend line (bullish).
EMA filter: keep the signal only if the signal candle closes above the fast EMA (9).
RSI filter: keep the signal only if RSI(14) is between Min RSI and Max RSI.
SuperTrend: bands = (high+low)/2 +/- multiplier x ATR(period); RSI: Wilder smoothing of 1-minute closes.
Rejected signals are counted in the scan summary ("Indicator filters: n checked, m rejected").
6. Portfolio optimizer (simulation only: no orders are placed)
Best MaxPositions signals share the stop-risk budget in proportion to score (water-filling).
Quantity = whole shares sized from the loss at the stop, incl. both legs' Zerodha fees + slippage.
Capped by: risk per trade, total stop risk, allocation per stock, bar-volume participation, cash.
A row whose target leaves no positive net gain after costs is skipped.
Sale proceeds from the Exit Monitor are added back to the next scan's cash.
7. Exit Monitor (every 15 s; also runs after each refresh)
Each portfolio row is treated as bought at the CLOSE of its signal candle; the next candle is the first that counts.
The day's 1-minute candles are replayed in order, so a restart gives the same answer. First rule hit ends the trade:
Reversal Guard: armed when the high covers 50% of the way to target; then stop -> buy + 5 bps (EXIT_BREAKEVEN).
Once armed, EXIT_REVERSAL on: 40% of peak gain given back, 3 lower closes below VWAP, or trend projected at/below buy.
Stop Reprieve (On): a dip to the stop with price back above it AND VWAP >= 1 stop-distance above price waits up to 15 min,
judged on completed closes (needs price below VWAP: normal for ScalpVwap, almost never true for VwapPullback).
Sold rows get a notification (if on) and free their cash for the next scan.
Arm after (% of way to target)
Sell when % of peak gain given back
Lower closes in a row (below VWAP)
Signals list + Signals grid, Portfolio list + Portfolio grid with per-row exit status, totals (invested, P&L, tracking).
Summary line names the strategy; diagnostics text explains how many candles passed each test.
CSV files saved at the market close (Share CSV / Export CSV any time). The app is READ-ONLY: it never places orders.
Save CSV files at market close
Blue = scan inputs Green = strategy rules Purple = portfolio Orange = Exit Monitor Dashed boxes = settings with default values (appsettings.json).
Defaults can be changed in Settings and are stored on the phone. Rules describe behavior only; they do not establish that the strategy is profitable.
